Basic exclusion amount 2025: $13,990,000; 2026: $15,000,000 (change $1,010,000). Annual gift exclusion $19,000 vs $19,000. Estate tax on a $20,000,000 taxable estate: $2,404,000 in 2025, $2,000,000 in 2026.

Federal estate and gift tax only. State estate and inheritance taxes are not included. General information, not legal or tax advice; Forms 706 and 709 and their instructions decide the official amounts.

structuredContent.law_note: P.L. 119-21 sec. 70106 (signed July 4, 2025) amended IRC sec. 2010(c)(3): the basic exclusion amount is $15,000,000 for decedents dying and gifts made in 2026, indexed for inflation after 2026 (rounded to the nearest $10,000), with no sunset. Before that law the TCJA doubling ($10,000,000 base) ended after 2025 and the base would have reverted to $5,000,000 indexed, about half. The top rate stays 40% (sec. 2001(c)).
